1.

This application under Section 529 of the B.N.S.S. has been filed by the aggrieved wife with a
prayer to direct the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 10, Jhansi to decide the Case No.
3813 of 2014 (State versus Rajesh Gupta and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 31/2013, under
Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station-Mahila Thana
Nawabad, District-Jhansi pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 10, Jhansi,
expeditiously within stipulated period.

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.
3.
It appears from the perusal of the record that on 07.08.2024 chargesheet was submitted in this matter and after presence of the accused persons the matter is pending at the stage of evidence.
Examination in chief of P.W.-1 of the informant was recorded, but the matter is still pending at the stage of cross examination of P.W.-1.

Learned trial court is not taking any interest for recording the cross examination of P.W.-1.
4.
It appears from the perusal of the record that the applicant is not cooperating with the court and she herself has been absent on several dates.

sentences.text: However, learned trial court is directed to record the cross examination of applicant after she appears on the date fixed for evidence and thereafterall possible endeavours shall be made for expeditious disposal of the case, provided the applicant cooperates with the trial court.
6. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
